narration: Local Kokoro ONNX af_heart, American English; new first-purchase narration with measured optional caption cues.
sources: Fresh real application recordings of one fictional restaurant and its first purchase. Public signup shows the actual approved-pilot Google entry; authentication is completed off camera in an isolated local environment. Supplier replies, award and delivery use the same real local request. No internal demo access or production writes. Actions may be condensed up to 1.5x; recordings do not promise loading speed.

scenes.title: Your first purchase
phrases: Let’s make a first purchase with Monsoon Table, our example restaurant.

scenes.title: Add your restaurant
phrases: Start with your restaurant’s name, contact number, and address.
Add your city, state and PIN code for the right delivery details.

scenes.title: Open your workspace
phrases: Enter the owner’s name and work email.
For approved pilot owners, continue with Google to create the workspace and open Today.
scenes.text: Enter the owner’s name and work email. For approved pilot owners, continue with Google to create the workspace and open Today.

scenes.title: Approve your first menu
phrases: Open Menu, choose Add menu, then type or paste a dish.
Here, we’re making tomato curry.
Review the ingredient, quantity and unit.
Approve the menu before using it for a purchase.
scenes.text: Open Menu, choose Add menu, then type or paste a dish. Here, we’re making tomato curry. Review the ingredient, quantity and unit. Approve the menu before using it for a purchase.

scenes.title: Add your suppliers
phrases: Open Suppliers and add the businesses you buy from.
Enter each business name and its ingredient categories.
We’ve added two example suppliers so we can compare their replies.
scenes.text: Open Suppliers and add the businesses you buy from. Enter each business name and its ingredient categories. We’ve added two example suppliers so we can compare their replies.

scenes.title: Create the first request
phrases: Choose New purchase. Give it a name and select the approved menu.
Check quantities. We need ten kilos of tomatoes.
Set the delivery date and reply deadline.
Choose your suppliers, save the draft, then open it for quotes.
scenes.text: Choose New purchase. Give it a name and select the approved menu. Check quantities. We need ten kilos of tomatoes. Set the delivery date and reply deadline. Choose your suppliers, save the draft, then open it for quotes.

scenes.title: Suppliers reply
phrases: Each supplier opens their private request link.
They enter a price, check delivery and the total, then send their quote.
Here are replies from our two example suppliers, for the same ten kilos.
scenes.text: Each supplier opens their private request link. They enter a price, check delivery and the total, then send their quote. Here are replies from our two example suppliers, for the same ten kilos.

scenes.title: Choose a supplier
phrases: Back in Purchases, compare the complete offers.
Check coverage, tax, delivery charges and dates.
Here, the totals are four hundred and four hundred forty rupees.
Choose the suitable supplier and confirm your decision.

scenes.title: Check what arrived
phrases: Now check what actually arrives.
We ordered ten kilos, but received nine.
Enter received quantities and check the invoice.
Record the missing kilo and forty rupees in credit still owed, then save.
